title: Creating Awareness among Students of Counselling Support
what_it_is: Creating Awareness among Students of Counselling Support

sections.label: School resilience and counselling support
sections.summary: Schools build resilience through co-curricular activities, outdoor education and camps, work with parents, and train teachers to identify and refer students in distress to school counsellors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Our schools also provide opportunities to build resilience when students experience, manage and overcome challenges through co-curricular activities and outdoor education programmes, including camps.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Schools work with parents and provide them with resources to help reinforce these skills and a resilient mindset at home and facilitate parenting workshops through the Parent Support Groups.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Our teachers are trained to identify students in distress and to refer them for counselling support by professionally trained school counsellors.

sections.label: Referrals, helplines and suicide review
sections.summary: Schools refer students and families to family service centres or mental health professionals, 24-hour helplines exist, and a further review of strategies and interventions to prevent suicides is underway.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Schools refer students and families requiring support to family service centres in the community, or to mental health professionals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Outside of school hours, 24-hour helplines are available.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Parents can also bring their children to seek medical help from their family doctor or the nearest hospital.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, we need to find out what are the other stressors that perhaps were not picked up by the existing system, and the processes that we have.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We are undertaking a further review of our strategies as well as our possible interventions to prevent suicides.
